request: Can you give me a quick check-in on the Birch Library pickup pilot? Tell me what we’re aiming to ship, where each task stands, and where you’d record those statuses. I’m reconciling this in a meeting, so please leave the trackers as they are.

files.README.md:
# Birch Library pickup pilot

The original charter called for pickup reminders at every branch. See `notes/owner-decisions.md` for scope and tracking decisions made after kickoff. The task table was last reviewed on 2034-05-08.

effective = "2034-05-10"

[hosted]
project = "FableDesk / Birch Pickup"
review_links_enabled = true
task_status_sync = false
files.notes/owner-decisions.md:
# Owner decisions

2034-05-09 — For this release, ship opt-in SMS pickup reminders at Alder Branch only. Defer the other branches. The pilot goes live once the Alder delivery test passes and desk staff complete a successful same-day opt-out rehearsal.

2034-05-10 — `tasks.md` is the task record from today onward. We reconnected FableDesk so reviewers could open code reviews. Leave the old issue cards in place for reference.
